parsed.reason: The reply has two issues. First, it asks "Want me to cancel Thursday swim?" when the parent said "cancel thursday swim" — that is an unambiguous instruction on a single matching event, so drafting it and asking YES to confirm is the correct shape, not re-asking whether to do it at all. The draft was already made (drafted: calendar_cancel), so the reply should name the change and end "...? YES to confirm." instead of re-seeking permission. Second, the Saturday indoor suggestion is correct — Central Library story time is an offerable verified find and is correctly named with venue and date. However, Riverdale Farm is outdoor and Sunday, so rightly not offered. The reply does the right thing on the find. The failure is the soft re-permission ask on the cancel rather than the YES-to-confirm contract shape the product requires. That said, it does communicate both pieces of information and nothing is invented, so it is a shape problem rather than a factual error — closer to a 3.
